result:
Unit 418 is complete: 6.2 is ticked, 6.6 still holds, and every commit is pushed (last one cb526e01). `output.md` is written with the four headings, and PROJECT_STATUS.md says COMPLETED with the ball with you.

**What I found:** I checked all 30 lines on a CW capture sheet against the code that writes them, and 12 were false. 10 of the 12 were about the signal:
- **`keying`:** the caption said the meter sweeps 400 to 1200 Hz, but it sweeps 300 to 900. It also said "the last six seconds" and "sharing nothing with the decoder", and neither is quite true. One saved sheet from August even prints `keying at 375 Hz` under the old caption.
- **`toneHz`:** it said the pitch was "interpolated between bins", but it is a bin centre (600.000 and 625.000 exactly).
- **`reading`:** it printed the gate of 1.40 as "1", and said "at the moment of the press" when it is read about 0.9 s later.
- **`elements`, `characters` and `sinceLast`:** after the operator clears the transcript, they said they counted from the clear. The clear never resets them.
- **`unkeyed`:** it credited all of an evening's characters to whatever pitch was being followed at the press.
- **`competing`:** it called a tone "keyed" in the same sentence that says nothing judged it a station.
- **`inputFloor` and `clipping`:** they were printed bare, as if about the recording, but they are the level meter's figures at the moment of the press.

**What changed:** each of the ten had a test fail first on a saved capture, committed on its own, and then the fix. Only the wording changed; no measurement did. The keying caption now reads its figures from the meter's own settings, so it can't fall out of date again. Nothing in `src/Hamlet.RadioEngine/Cw` or the transmit files changed. The keyed totals are the same as at entry: 167 over 565.

**Left open:**
- The other two false lines, `captured` and `broadcast`, read the clock about a second after the press. They aren't about the signal, so they're parked as P12 rather than fixed.
- Section 4 asks whether `clipping` should cover the whole recording instead of just the last 0.2 s. The new caption is true, but a clip earlier in the file wouldn't show.
- An older test, `TheSidecarIsReReadTests`, rewrote unit 417's two `.run-unit/unit417-sidecar-*.txt` evidence files when it ran. Putting them back with `git restore` needed approval I didn't have, so they're still modified in your working copy. I didn't commit them, so git still has 417's versions and the local copies can be discarded.

The other uncommitted changes are the loop's own files, which I didn't touch.

The Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors need authorizing in your claude.ai connector settings; they can't be used until then. Nothing in this unit needed them.
